pr_title: Fix bug when nested knn pre-filter might match nested docs
pr_body:
When using a pre-filter with nested kNN vectors, its treated like a top-level filter. Meaning, it is applied over parent document fields. 

However, there are times when a query filter is applied that may or may not match internal nested or non-nested docs. We failed to handle this case correctly and users would receive an error.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/105901
pr_comments: Hi @benwtrent, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
